connector.name: Pubcrawl
connector.registryDescription: PubMed & Europe PMC literature search, US/UK drug labelling, and clinical trials for AI assistants.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package pubcrawl. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nickjlamb account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NCBI_API_KEY
env.description: NCBI API key for higher rate limits (10 req/s vs 3 req/s). Optional — get one free at https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/account/
